An '''individual''' was a customer of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Neeamesh Dym]] who became angry at the smuggler and [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Dym. The villain<ref name="db2">{{DB|starship|dustyduck|Dusty Duck}}</ref> was later killed by [[Rango Tel]]<ref name="Starships">{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|26|Starship & Vehicle Directory}}</ref> during a drunken [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] brawl.<ref name="mag7">{{SW|url=news/the-not-so-magnificent-seven|text=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|int=The Not-So Magnificent Seven|nolive=1}}</ref>
